title: Pedro phase 6 regression smoke combined candidate
body: CONFIRMED: The single paid RTX 4090 job 5b95c01e-38ea-4df4-a75f-f655ed53b7ce-u1 completed the combined scene-roi-v4 legacy_refined path. The final 150-frame delivery showed zero neon-green pixels inside the frozen composition masks versus 159607 across 26 frames in v4_old, and the lossless master changed zero decoded pixels outside the frozen broad regions. LIMIT: pure DiffuEraser and complete per-scene reports were persisted on the network volume but not transferred, so the result confirms the combined candidate and cannot isolate the causal contribution of subtitle-junctions.
